environment: Linux x86_64 virtual desktop, 1364x1024, native GUI maximized and focused, dark theme, saved three-node 11808-triangle vase
method: Read /proc/<PID>/stat utime+stime twice and /proc/<PID>/status VmRSS/VmHWM, 12 seconds apart, verifying the executable path
limitations: One 12-second settled GUI sample after manual interactions; native window remained focused, verified through window inventory; not startup time or frame latency
Resident memory excludes separate graphics-server processes and is not GPU memory
No Intel Arc or Windows hardware inference
0 ticks at 100 Hz is a quantized observation, not proof of literal zero CPU use; one tick over this sample is about 0.08333 percent of one core.
scope_note: Measurement command was sent to a bound terminal window without activating it; the GUI retained window-manager focus throughout the observed sample.
